meta.title: Our financing — OrentaLoan
meta.description: 14 types of financing assessed on your real situation. Loans backed by collateral stay within reach after a bank refusal.

index.title: Financing for every situation
index.intro: We put forward loans backed by collateral or an asset: they stay within reach when the score blocks you. Classic financing follows.

common.rateNote: Indicative rates, non-binding, subject to change and to review of your file.
common.ctaFinalTitle: We study your file, not your score.

models.revolving: A revolving credit does not amortise like a classic loan: its cost depends on your usage and how fast you repay. Use the general simulator with care, or talk to an advisor.
models.leasing: With a lease you pay rentals then, optionally, a residual value. The calculation depends on the asset and its buy-back value; an advisor sets a precise rental.
models.bridge: A bridging loan is repaid in full at the sale of your property. Its cost depends on the actual time to sale and the amount advanced.
models.factoring: Factoring is not a loan: you assign invoices in exchange for an advance, for a commission. The cost depends on your volume and your payment terms.

rachat-credit.name: Debt consolidation
rachat-credit.teaser: Combine your loans into a single monthly payment, backed by your property if needed.
rachat-credit.heroSubtitle: Combine your loans into a single monthly payment, backed by your property where needed.
rachat-credit.description: Debt consolidation combines your running loans into one, with a lower monthly payment and a re-spread term. Backed by an asset, it can be studied even after a payment incident.
eligible: Owner wishing to combine several loans
Tight budget with an asset to pledge
Varied work situation, self-employed included
notEligible: Tenant without a guarantor and an already very high debt ratio
No existing loans to combine
documents: Amortization schedules of the loans to combine
Proof of ownership or property tax

faq.q: Does consolidation clear a credit listing?
faq.a: No. It can settle the loans behind the incident, which may lead to a delisting, but no removal is automatic or guaranteed.

faq.q: How far can the term be extended?
faq.a: Up to 420 months for consolidation backed by a property, within the limit of your repayment capacity.
Yes, an extra envelope can be included if your collateral and income allow.

case.title: Combining three loans
case.detail: €80,000 combined over 180 months: a single payment replaces three instalments, for a re-spread and known cost.

pret-travaux.name: Home-improvement loan
pret-travaux.teaser: Finance a renovation, including energy-efficiency works.
pret-travaux.heroSubtitle: Finance a renovation, including energy-saving works.
pret-travaux.description: The home-improvement loan finances upgrading your home, from a refresh to an energy renovation. It can top up public grants.
eligible: Owner-occupier or landlord
Energy renovation eligible for grants
Steady income, even modest, with quotes to support it
notEligible: Works without a quote or proof of use
Repayment capacity already maxed out

faq.q: Can I combine it with a public renovation grant?
faq.a: Yes. The home-improvement loan tops up grants; the amounts received are not part of the credit.

faq.q: Are the funds paid out at once?
faq.a: Depending on the works, a staged release against invoices is possible.

faq.q: Do I have to be an owner?
faq.a: Usually yes, but a tenant doing works with the owner's consent can be studied.

case.title: Energy renovation
case.detail: €25,000 over 84 months for insulation and a heat pump, on top of grants.

pret-tresorerie.name: Cash-flow loan
pret-tresorerie.teaser: Get over a cash-flow bump for your business, without tying up your funds.
pret-tresorerie.heroSubtitle: Get over a cash-flow bump for your business, without tying up your assets.
pret-tresorerie.description: The cash-flow loan covers a working-capital need: a payment gap, a seasonal load, a passing hit. Assessed on the reality of your business.
eligible: Micro-business or self-employed with an established activity
A justifiable one-off working-capital need
A business account with steady movements
notEligible: Business created less than six months ago with no track record
A structural long-term need better suited to another product
documents: Last two sets of accounts or interim figures

faq.q: Do I need three sets of accounts?
faq.a: No. Recent interim figures and steady statements can be enough for the review.
After acceptance and signing the offer, funds are paid out within the legal timeframe.
Depending on the amount, a director's guarantee or security may be requested.

case.title: Cash-flow gap
case.detail: €30,000 over 48 months to absorb a customer-payment gap, repaid as collections come in.

loa.name: Lease / hire-purchase
loa.teaser: Use a vehicle or equipment without buying it right away.
loa.heroSubtitle: Use a vehicle or equipment without buying it, with a purchase option at the end.
loa.description: A lease with a purchase option has you pay rentals for the use of an asset, with the option to buy it at its residual value. The cost is spread, the asset stays the collateral.
eligible: Private individual or business wanting use without an immediate purchase
Steady income covering the rental
A project on an identifiable vehicle or equipment
notEligible: Looking for cash in hand (a lease finances use)
An asset that is uninsurable or hard to resell
documents: Order form or quote for the asset

faq.a: Not during the lease. You own it if you exercise the purchase option at the set residual value.
Depending on the contract; some plans include maintenance and insurance.

faq.q: Can I return the asset at the end?
faq.a: Yes. Without exercising the option, you return the asset in the condition set out in the contract.

case.title: Vehicle on lease
case.detail: €30,000 value, 48 rentals then a residual value: you choose to buy or return.

affacturage.name: Factoring
affacturage.teaser: Turn your customer invoices into available cash immediately.
affacturage.heroSubtitle: Turn your customer invoices into available cash immediately.
affacturage.description: Factoring is not a loan: you assign your outstanding invoices in exchange for an immediate advance, for a commission. Your cash flow follows your turnover.
eligible: Business invoicing professional customers
A recurring receivables book with payment terms
A need to smooth cash flow without taking on debt
notEligible: B2C activity without professional invoices
Disputed or already overdue receivables

faq.a: No. It is an assignment of receivables against an advance; it does not increase your bank debt.
Depending on the plan, chasing and collection can be delegated to the factor.
A factoring commission and a financing commission, depending on volume and terms. No fee before set-up.

case.title: Advance on invoices
case.detail: A €100,000 receivables book financed within a few days, at the pace of your invoicing.

pret-relais.name: Bridging loan
pret-relais.teaser: Buy before you have sold, over the transition period.
pret-relais.heroSubtitle: Buy a new property before selling the current one, over the transition period.
pret-relais.description: The bridging loan advances part of the value of the property you are selling. You repay the capital at the sale; in the meantime, you usually pay only the interest.
eligible: Owner selling a property to buy another
A property on the market at a realistic value
The ability to carry the interest during the bridge
notEligible: A property that is hard to sell or over-valued
No concrete purchase project in front of it
documents: Valuation or sale mandate for the property

faq.q: What if I don't sell in time?
faq.a: The bridging loan has a limited term (12 to 24 months). An exit is planned and discussed from the start.
Usually a cautious share of the estimated value, to account for the market.

faq.q: Do I pay the capital each month?
faq.a: No. The capital is repaid at the sale; you pay only the interest, depending on the chosen plan.

case.title: Buy before selling
case.detail: €200,000 advanced over 12 months with partial deferral: you pay only the interest until the sale.

pret-immobilier.name: Home loan
pret-immobilier.teaser: Finance a property purchase assessed on your real situation.
pret-immobilier.heroSubtitle: Finance a property purchase assessed on your real situation, not on a score.
pret-immobilier.description: The home loan finances the purchase of your home or an investment. We study atypical files: self-employed, short contracts, profiles turned away elsewhere.
eligible: A purchase with a down payment or collateral
Steady income, non-salaried included
An atypical profile but a solid file otherwise
notEligible: Debt clearly beyond prudential thresholds without collateral
No down payment and no property to mortgage
documents: Last three payslips or sets of accounts

faq.q: Do you accept the self-employed without three years of accounts?
faq.a: Yes, under conditions: an established business and steady statements can make up for it.
Not always, but it clearly strengthens the file and the rate.
Fixed or variable depending on the term; the table above gives indicative pointers.

case.title: Buying a home
case.detail: €200,000 over 240 months: a monthly payment known in advance, calculated to the cent.

credit-consommation.name: Consumer credit
credit-consommation.teaser: Finance a personal project, equipment or an unexpected expense.
credit-consommation.heroSubtitle: Finance a personal project, equipment or an unexpected expense.
credit-consommation.description: Consumer credit finances an identified need without mortgaging an asset. Measured amounts and terms, assessed on your real budget.
eligible: Steady income covering the monthly payment
An identifiable personal project
A controlled debt ratio
notEligible: A budget already stretched by other loans
Cash requested without a clear repayment capacity

faq.a: A clear review time is stated, and we stick to it.
Yes, at any time, under the legal conditions set out in the contract.
Depending on the amount and type of credit; we tell you at review.

case.title: Personal project
case.detail: €15,000 over 48 months: monthly payment, total cost and APR shown before any signature.

pret-auto.name: Car loan
pret-auto.teaser: Buy a new or used vehicle, with a clear monthly payment.
pret-auto.heroSubtitle: Buy a new or used vehicle, with a clear monthly payment.
pret-auto.description: The car loan finances the purchase of a vehicle. The asset can serve as collateral, which opens financing to varied profiles.
eligible: Purchase of an identifiable new or used vehicle
Steady income
A profile accepted thanks to the vehicle collateral
notEligible: A vehicle without a usable invoice or registration
Repayment capacity insufficient despite the collateral

faq.q: Are new and used both financed?
faq.a: Yes, with terms adapted to the vehicle's age.
Depending on the plan, a lien may be taken as collateral.
Borrower insurance is optional and can be included in the monthly payment.

case.title: Used car
case.detail: €20,000 over 60 months, secured by the financed vehicle.

credit-renouvelable.name: Revolving credit
credit-renouvelable.teaser: A flexible reserve of money, to be used with care.
credit-renouvelable.heroSubtitle: A flexible reserve of money, to be used with care.
credit-renouvelable.description: Revolving credit provides a reserve you use freely and rebuild as you repay. Flexible but costly: keep it for small one-off needs.
eligible: A one-off need of a small amount
The ability to repay fast to limit the cost
Steady income
notEligible: A long project, where an amortising loan costs far less
Difficulty repaying more than the interest each month

faq.a: Flexibility has a cost. The faster you repay, the less interest you pay.

faq.q: Am I obliged to use the reserve?
faq.a: No. Interest only runs on the amount actually used.

faq.q: Is it suitable for a big purchase?
faq.a: Rarely. For a project, an amortising loan is almost always cheaper.

case.title: Small one-off need
case.detail: €3,000 used then repaid over 24 months: the cost depends directly on your repayment pace.

pret-etudiant.name: Student loan
pret-etudiant.teaser: Finance studies and their living costs.
pret-etudiant.heroSubtitle: Finance studies and their living costs, with adapted repayment.
pret-etudiant.description: The student loan finances tuition and everyday life, often with deferred repayment during studies. A guarantor strengthens the file.
eligible: Student enrolled at a recognised institution
A guarantor or security available
A study project consistent with the amount
notEligible: No guarantor and no credible future income
An amount unrelated to the course

faq.a: Yes, a partial or full deferral during studies is common; interest runs depending on the plan.
It is usually necessary and clearly improves the terms.
Student rates are among the lowest; see the indicative table above.

case.title: Financing a course
case.detail: €15,000 over 60 months with deferral during studies, repaid on entering working life.

financement-equipement.name: Equipment financing
financement-equipement.teaser: Finance machines, equipment or business vehicles.
financement-equipement.heroSubtitle: Finance machines, equipment or business vehicles without straining your cash flow.
financement-equipement.description: Equipment financing funds a productive asset, which often serves as collateral. It preserves your cash flow for operations.
eligible: Business investing in identifiable equipment
A resaleable asset serving as collateral
An activity with steady accounts
notEligible: Obsolete or hard-to-resell equipment
A business without demonstrable repayment capacity
documents: Quote or pro-forma invoice for the equipment

faq.q: Does the equipment serve as collateral?
faq.a: Often yes, which eases approval even for a young structure.
Both are possible; an advisor compares depending on your tax position and needs.
Aligned with the equipment's useful life, up to 84 months.

case.title: Equipment purchase
case.detail: €40,000 over 60 months for a productive asset, secured on the financed item.

pret-creation-reprise.name: Start-up / buy-out loan
pret-creation-reprise.teaser: Finance the launch or buy-out of a business.
pret-creation-reprise.heroSubtitle: Finance the launch or buy-out of a business, beyond personal funds.
pret-creation-reprise.description: The start-up / buy-out loan tops up your own funds to launch or acquire a business. The file rests on the project, the forecast and collateral.
eligible: A project holder with a costed business plan
Personal funds or co-financing
A buy-out with usable accounts
notEligible: A project with no funds, collateral or forecast
A sector with no visibility on income

faq.a: Own funds, even modest, are decisive; they can be topped up by start-up grants.
Yes, based on the target's accounts and your buy-out plan.
Often, as a director's guarantee or a dedicated body's security.

case.title: Business buy-out
case.detail: €60,000 over 60 months alongside own funds, backed by the buy-out forecast.

immobilier-professionnel.name: Commercial property loan
immobilier-professionnel.teaser: Finance commercial walls or professional premises.
immobilier-professionnel.heroSubtitle: Finance commercial walls or professional premises.
immobilier-professionnel.description: The commercial property loan finances the purchase of business premises. The asset is the collateral, which opens financing to varied structures.
eligible: A business buying its walls or operating premises
A professional asset serving as collateral
Accounts evidencing repayment capacity
notEligible: Premises with no real professional use
A structure whose debt is already critical

faq.a: Both structures are studied; an advisor guides you by your situation.
Up to 240 months, depending on the asset and the structure.
Both exist; the table above gives indicative pointers.

case.title: Buying the walls
case.detail: €300,000 over 180 months to acquire premises, secured by the asset itself.
